question: Which cells, condition aliases, annotations and RNA layers are actually retained in the main Navarro IL10 Seurat deposit?
decision: Determine eligibility and scope for a separately frozen finite-pool RNA description; hold uncertain aliases/layers and retain absent donor provenance.
strongest_rival: Mistaken alias-to-dose, cell-population or assay-layer identity could create an apparent ligand difference; one condition pool cannot establish independent mouse replication.
discriminator: Compare actual object fields and alignment with immutable S1/source crosswalk and archived author code; independently reconstruct sampled RNA normalization. This cannot recover physically pooled mice.
exposure_record: Paper figures, captions, published markers, source/animal results and author code exposed. The biological RDS has not been deserialized before this first metadata freeze; earlier acquisition used only opaque byte hashes. V1 exposed object class Seurat and peak operational memory only before version serialization failed; no inventory or normalization results were produced.
biological_unit: One deposited pool/library per condition; cells nested in the observed pool, not independent mice.
nesting_and_overlap: S1 reports one old-control mouse and two pooled mice in the other main libraries, with no multiplexing. Shared controls serve both dose contrasts. Individual donor assignment requires separate provenance.
population_and_selection: All retained cells in the authorized main IL10_svz_seurat.rds and original broad Celltype annotations. No fresh clustering, integration, downsampling or marker-based exclusion.
contrast: Metadata eligibility across every observed condition and broad cell type; no treatment-expression contrasts in this stage.
endpoint: Class/slot/layer inventory, barcode/matrix alignment, metadata completeness, cell recovery, QC threshold retention, donor-like fields/provenance and sampled log-normalization arithmetic.
methods: R/Matrix/SeuratObject direct sparse slot access. Config fixes condition/annotation fields, deterministic condition-stratified cells and evenly spaced plus nonzero genes. Compare stored RNA data with log1p(count/library_total*recorded scale), tolerance 1e-10. Inventory command parameters and all observed aliases.
missingness_and_exclusions: No new exclusions. Missing fields, absent genes/conditions, explicit sparse zeros, duplicate/misaligned barcodes and source discrepancies are reported. A failed required check stops dependent analyses rather than selecting favorable records.
multiplicity: Metadata and arithmetic checks only; no inferential P values or confidence intervals.
precision_basis: No population precision estimate. Exact stored recovery counts and bounded numerical tolerance qualify file arithmetic only.
interpretation_limit: No biological replication, population treatment effect, age interaction, mediation or repair inference. Downstream microglia exclusions and filename changes must remain distinct from broad deposited cells.
stop_rule: Stop on source hash mismatch, incompatible sparse layers, barcode/gene misalignment, incomplete required labels, invalid raw counts, or operational limits. Normalization mismatch holds descriptive RNA stage; preserve failures and use a new committed amendment for changes.
amendment_reason: V1 loaded the Seurat object but recursed serializing its numeric_version S3 list. V2 converts that class to its character version before recursive list handling. No sampling, QC, normalization or selection rule changes; failed receipt preserved.
